content: रचनम्, -ना [रच्-युच्] .²1 Arrangement, preparation, disposition; अभिषेक˚, संगीत˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Formation, creation, production; अन्यैव कापि रचना वचनावलीनाम् <ls>Bv. 1. 69</ls>; so भ्रुकुटिरचना <ls>Me. 52</ls>; शृङ्गारोत्तरसत्प्रमेयरचनैराचार्यगोवर्धनः <ls>Gīt.</ls> .²3 Performance, completion, accomplishment, effecting; कुरु मम वचनं सत्वरर चनम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 77</ls>. .²4 A literary work or production, work, composition; संक्षिप्ता वस्तुरचना <ls>S. D. 422</ls>. .²5 Dressing the hair. .²6 An array or arrangement of troops. .²7 A creation of the mind, an artificial fancy. .²8 Stringing together (flowers <ab>&c.</ab>). .²9 Contrivance, invention. .²10 Fixing the feathers on an arrow.
